quest.title: A Pact That Crosses Time
quest.description: Accepting the commission of the Tianshu, Uncle Tian, Ganyu very naturally slips into her work mode, coming to the aid of her junior colleague Huixin with ease in the latter's time of need. To express her thanks, Huixin invites you all to Xinyue Kiosk to have a meal...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x425, Primogem x60, Mora x26025, Guide to Diligence x5, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

chapter.title: Sea of Clouds, Sea of People

talks.objective: Go to Xinyue Kiosk for the meal appointment

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Ms. Ganyu, thank you for accepting my invitation. And as for the two of you, your presence is also much appreciated.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure!

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: That's so kind of you, Huixin. You went to great lengths to organize this.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Ha, truth be told... Apart from thanking you for all the help, there's something I'd like to tell you...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Oh? If there's anything I can help you with, just tell me straight away. No need to hesitate.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Ah... No, no, I don't really need help. Uh... Could you just listen for a bit?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: With pleasure.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Ha... When I was a little girl, my father used to tell me many stories about you, Ms. Ganyu.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Even though I have the utmost respect for my father... I always admired how gentle and reliable you are.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: I only decided to join the Yuehai Pavilion staff because I've always looked up to you.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I didn't know that you think so highly of me.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: However, in reality, working at the Yuehai Pavilion turned out to be an arduous task.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: I can't compare myself to such an outstanding secretary like you. I often doubt myself as a result...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I disagree. You're a great secretary in your own right.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Aha, thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Over the years, I became a mother, too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh! So Uncle Tian is a grandpa!

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Influenced by my youthful ideals, she followed my footsteps and came to be a secretary at the Yuehai Pavilion, too.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: At first, I was worried about her. It's not an easy job, after all. To tell the truth, I'm still unsure if she's capable enough.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: But after all that happened this time, I've... made up my mind to support her choice.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: So, what made you change your mind?

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: The fact that she'll have you, Ms. Ganyu, as her senior colleague.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: You'll help her, gentle as always, and tell her, "Your mom used to do it like that." Heh.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: It'd be such a beautiful moment.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: If it's not too much to ask for, she might still need your guidance in twenty plus years, too.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Huixin...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I... I never thought that I meant so much to you.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Heh, just like when you showed me my father's trick. Having you as their "witness" makes people feel at ease.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: "Witness"...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: ...It's true that I've witnessed thousands of years of Liyue Harbor's history. All the changes it's gone through, the stories of its people...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: But I've always regarded it as nothing more than the source of my loneliness.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Huixin, you don't know how important those words are to me...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: You've made me realize that I share another connection with the people of Liyue Harbor, apart from my contract with Rex Lapis.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: They rely on me, accept me, and long for me to bear witness to their stories.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Of course! You're irreplaceable to us!

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Ehehe... That's right. That's why I can't disappoint you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hooray! Ganyu's finally cheered up!

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Even if I've really been supplanted, I wish to fight for my place...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I won't let you down. I'm going to fulfill my contract and keep working as the Qixing's secretary.

choices.text: Uh... I told you, you haven't been...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Regardless, I'll go back and see for myself.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I'm afraid that it might've all become a mess during my absence.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: No time to waste — let's get back to work!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huuuuh!? We leaving already? Paimon's still hungry!

choices.text: You haven't been fired. It's a misunderstanding.

talks.objective: Talk to the Jade Chamber secretaries
Talk to the Jade Chamber secretaries

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: Ahhhh...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Baishi, are you okay? Did you fall asleep standing up?

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: Look... Look who's back!

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: You even have enough time for leisure? It seems you three are a suitable replacement for me after all.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Not at all! We just... We've been working for too long. If we didn't take a break...

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: We wouldn't have survived long enough to see you again, Ms. Ganyu.

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: Ms. Ganyu, we've missed you...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Ehehe. That's so kind of you all, given we've only met once.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: We've been praying day and night for you to return and take over your duties again.

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: To us, you're like an adeptus coming down to the human world to save all life.

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: Forget all our envious complaints from before — just free us from this strenuous work, please...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Please divide the matters at hand into government affairs, business affairs, and civil affairs. Mark out the tasks that haven't been started and those that are in progress...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I'll take care of the rest.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Of course! We'll do it right away!

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: Finally... We're saved...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, there's one more thing.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I'd like to earnestly thank you, Traveler. If it weren't for your companionship, I would still be embroiled in my inner conflict right now.

choices.text: It was a fun adventure for me, too.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Hehe, to think that I'd gain a human friend outside of work. It makes me happier than I could've imagined.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I'd like to repay you when I'm done with the work at hand. What would you say if I... accompanied you on one of your trips?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure, but... are you ever done with work, Ganyu?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Uh, let's cross that bridge when we come to it, shall we...

choices.text: It's good that you've pulled yourself together.
